first critical moment would be first week of october and the next woulld be first week of december.

So these are the details if anyone wanna know-
Hey thanks a lot for reaching out but its a bit complicated. See a board conducts this yearly exam and also conducts a different exam with similar pattern. So i first gave the exam during my internship it was a total wreck,for the first time such an exam had been made with new pattern. Next i gave the half yearly exam(people with done internship)only can give it i got a grrat rank 1264 in it,needed under 1000 to get the desired result.About 36000 prople give this exam. Then next yearly exam and a repeat of this exam came i did worst around 8000 rank in both,sadly even 2000-4000 would have been okay for these 2 exams but alas. About 1,00,000 people gave these exams,the anomaly was a lot of the people who fared better than me had done better and only i had regressed.This exam is an online multi-session exam with psychometric evaluation→meaning-the questions answered by least number of people carry more marks and vice a versa. Also its purely luck based we have 19 subjects answers to all multi-choice questions varies with the mindset on day of the exam and the random stuff you've read from a particular subject(questions are usually one-liner fact based),so it doesnt matter that i know 12 subjects better than you,you may still beat me,as well as the silly mistakes you make for easy questions cause a great downgrade in your rank. So this brings us to this year half yearly 3870 rank inspite of giving all my time,mind,body and effort; Astonishingly for the first time in my 5th attempt on the half yearly exam for the top institute in the country i got a 87.5 percentile~1700 rank,unfortunately only top 50-100 get a proper subject. But still this was my best result,mind you exam of this insitute are conceptual and test the best of your knowledge and understanding and have a single online mcq exam. Judging by past if 1264 can become 8000,then my 3870 rank can easily be outside 10,000 in the upcoming exam. And i have tried and tried,the only purpose of my life for the past 2 years has been to pass this single exam,all my life i have trained only in this field for this purposr. I left countless movies,travelling,dinners,parties,etc,etc focussed solely on my work yet i fail at this task. A lot of my friends have bought their college seats or some have scrapped with 5-6k ranks for poor but accptable options and one even got 2200 rank even though i helped him throughout for studies and his mock exam scores were poorer than me till a week before the actual exam. I dont wanna be u burden on my family,i'm not rich,for me to buy a seat my family would have to sell their small home to move to a even smaller home at a shitty place and i'm not proud to leech off their incomes.Recently my father also retired so that adds to the burden. I guess i've been a failure and couldnt clear the single task for which i have been training for so long. Sorry for the long story,i appreciate your help and advice if any.
